title: Cost Reduction — Logistics Charge Analysis and Recovery (SBA)
summary: I analyzed logistics charges under Supplier Billing Accuracy (SBA) to identify opportunities to lower costs. The project recovered overpayments from a major manufacturing partner.
context: Supplier billing accuracy was a separate financial control issue within the procurement portfolio. The project focused on identifying amounts paid in excess and pursuing recovery.
decisions: I analyzed logistics charges, worked to resolve supplier billing discrepancies and helped recover the overpayments.
outcome: The SBA project recovered US$4 million in supplier overpayments and received a separate Dell Winning Together recognition.
